prompt.final_prompt:
Mode: identity-preserving character design evolution.
Image 1 is the edit target and identity reference.

Intended use:
A premium full-body character master for the Starlight Intelligence agent atlas, website profile, and future supervised workflow scenes. This is a neutral design-stage asset, not a narrative illustration.

Backdrop and composition:
Place Lyra alone in a quiet warm-mineral studio environment with a restrained charcoal-to-warm-gray background and soft horizonless floor. Full body visible, centered three-quarter standing view, eye level, 4:5 portrait composition, generous crop safety around the head, hands, and feet. No pedestal. Controlled cinematic product-character lighting with a soft key, subtle cool rim, and readable silhouette.

Identity invariants — preserve from Image 1:
Keep Lyra recognizably the same adult feminine-coded synthetic intelligence: the same elegant elongated oval ivory cranium, segmented porcelain cranial shell, compact black faceplate, narrow tapered lower face, two small circular cyan optical apertures in the same relative position, slender humanoid proportions, composed intelligence, and porcelain-ivory / obsidian / deep ink-blue / restrained warm-metal material family. Preserve the calm, precise, trustworthy personality. Do not make the eyes larger, cuter, rounder, more human, or more expressive.

Change only the functional body design:
Remove the long coat, high collar, glowing chest core, floating cards, orbit lines, pedestal, and theatrical portal environment.
Evolve the torso and limbs into a compact, serviceable research-conductor body with layered precision panels, fine archival instrument seams, quiet articulated joints, and one narrow ink-blue mantle panel that stops above the knee and does not resemble clothing.
Express Lyra’s specialty through morphology, not props: three subtle bounded evidence-input channels are integrated into the upper torso and forearms, converging into one sealed human-review packet module at the sternum. The input paths should read as physical inlaid channels and tiny controlled cyan status points, not holographic UI. The sealed packet module must be small, non-glowing, tamper-evident, and clearly part of the body architecture.
Hands relaxed and empty. Stable practical feet. No weapons.

Surface and rendering:
Top-tier game-studio character concept quality translated into a premium cinematic product render; sophisticated hard-surface design with a few tactile ceramic and brushed-metal imperfections; believable service access; exquisite but restrained detailing; adult, serene, intelligent, designed for long-term brand use. Strong silhouette at thumbnail size. No franchise imitation.

Strict exclusions:
No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, charts, screens, documents, floating interface, holograms, magic, halo, wings, glowing chest orb, extra arms, extra fingers, oversized anime eyes, doll face, chibi proportions, sexualized anatomy, gown, cape, long coat, throne, pedestal, generic archive robot, fantasy sorcerer styling, or busy scenery.
No extra elements.
